subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting in a row, facing north. Only B sits to the left of A. Only four people sit between B and Q. Only E sits between R and P and R is not an immediate neighbour of Q. Who sits at the extreme right of the row?
solution:
Given, Seven people, A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only B sits to the left of A.

Only four people sit between B and Q.
